entries.title: Ask Firstmate to change, pause or delete an automation
entries.body: Firstmate can now do anything to an automation that you can in Settings → Automation: edit it, pause or resume it, pause them all, or delete it. It turns on an automation waiting as a draft only when you ask. Activity now names who made each change, you or Firstmate, such as "Captain · Automation paused - Weekly dependency audit".

picture.alt: Settings → Automation after asking Firstmate to turn on Morning digest: it reads Running, every day at 8:00 AM, beside Weekly dependency audit, which is paused
